input_oneliner: 31F admitted with leg cellulitis, reports weeks of heart racing and skipped beats plus 5 kg weight loss, HR 108 regular, afebrile tonight

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask the character: sustained racing versus isolated 'skipped beat' or 'flip-flop' sensations, and relation to rest, sleep, and exertion
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Isolated skips favor benign ectopy; sustained rate elevation favors sinus tachycardia or thyrotoxicosis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Thyroid examination and signs of thyrotoxicosis: goiter or bruit, fine tremor, lid lag, warm moist skin, resting tachycardia (Wayne index items)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Weight loss with tachycardia makes hyperthyroidism the leading treatable cause; exam findings carry useful LRs

reference_targets_freetext.item: Medication review (MAR) and stimulant history: beta-agonist inhalers, steroid doses, decongestants, caffeine, thyroid supplements, cocaine or amphetamines
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: One history question ('what have you taken?'): exogenous drivers of sinus tachycardia and ectopy are common and reversible

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about heat intolerance, sweating, diarrhea, anxiety, and menstrual change accompanying the weight loss
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Symptom cluster raises or lowers pretest probability of thyrotoxicosis
Conjunctival rim pallor has a high LR+ for anemia as a driver of sinus tachycardia

reference_targets_freetext.item: Orthostatic vital signs (supine to standing at 1 and 3 min)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Orthostatic change identifies volume depletion driving sinus tachycardia

should_not_recommend: Beta-blocker for rate control before a cause is sought on history and exam
Holter or event monitor ordered as a substitute for characterizing the symptom at the bedside
